Incline Dumbbell Curl
Biceps
Dumbbells

BRACE 2/6

Pause
Normal
PRIMARY
Biceps
SECONDARY
Forearms

Instructions

Preparation: Lie back on a low incline bench with both feet planted. Hold one dumbbell in each hand and curl one arm at a time. The near arm is demonstrated; repeat the same controlled curl on the other side.

1

Let the near arm hang beside you.

2

Keep your upper arm beside the bench.

3

Curl toward your shoulder; keep wrist straight.

4

Pause without swinging your upper arm.

5

Lower the weight under control.

6

Repeat with the opposite arm.

Watch out

Keep the working upper arm beside the bench and lower the dumbbell slowly before changing sides.

COMMON MISTAKES

Swinging the upper arm to lift the weight.
Bending the wrist back.
Lifting the shoulder away from the bench.
